text:
deploybot: PRELIGHT EVAL: prompt/eval gate FAILED for release v2.18.1 on email-summarizer-suite. key metric: ROUGE-L delta -4.5% (regression). 8/60 cases noisy. Promotion blocked pending exception or targeted pin/rollback. full report: https://internal.redwood/evals/4976543210 :warning:

maya: @deploybot can you dump the top failing examples and whether this affects documented release notes? need quick impact assessment for legal/support.

deploybot: top failures (abbrev):
```
1) "Weekly sync summary" -> dropped action item about SLA date
2) "Welcome/onboarding email" -> assigned wrong team for owner
3) "Migration notice" -> omitted migration step for DB move
```
noisy: tests 7, 22 are flaky across runs. systemic: tests 1, 3, 5 fail on every run.

liam: anything in last night's rollout that touches quant or attention scheduling? change list was large.

anya: yes—rolled attention-scaling tweak (ATTN_SCALE v2->v3) plus small int8 quant rounding change. I re-ran a local eval and the migration notice omission reproduces on ATTN_SCALE v3. ATTN_SCALE v2 returns baseline.

maya: product/legal: the migration step is called out in release notes and in the customer migration guide. If summaries omit it customers will hit support/SLA questions. Proposal: do a region-scoped pin to ATTN_SCALE v2 for EU customers (highest usage of the migration path) and continue with v3 elsewhere while we triage. Thoughts?

jin: QA: confirmed repro on v3 in staging, and also saw longer-context degradation in a subset of prompts. Region-scoped pin makes sense as a short-term mitigation. We'll run focused regressions after pin.

sam: ops: we can do region-scoped routing to pin EU to the v2 serving variant. ETA ~30m to create the route and propagate. Global pin is faster but heavier; partial pin gives least disruption.

liam: agree with partial pin + triage. plan: 1) create eu-only pin to v2 2) kick off bisect on ATTN_SCALE change 3) prepare a tiny canary patch with fallback thresholds. No objections?

maya: approved from PM/legal. Please add a non-technical line in the release notes: "Serving variant adjusted for EU customers to ensure migration guidance is preserved; improvements to be reintroduced after validation." Keep it short.

anya: starting bisect now; suspect normalization step in kernel ATTEN_NORM. will post findings to RD-8010.

sam: running ops command now:
```
/deploybot pin-route --service email-summarizer --variant ATTN_SCALE_v2 --scope region=eu --duration 6h --reason "preflight regression: email-summarizer-suite"
```
I'll update when the route is active. :gear:

sam: route creation complete at 4976543245 — traffic shaping in progress.

deploybot: detected new route; re-running preflight against targeted EU traffic. re-run result: PASS for EU subset at 4976543268. overall gate: still BLOCKED for full global promotion due to non-EU regressions; recommending proceed with release if leadership accepts eu-scoped pin.

maya: PM sign-off for release with EU pin. I'll edit release notes and notify support. thanks team. :white_check_mark:

jin: QA will run the follow-up sweep against other suites and confirm no additional breakage.

liam: created ticket RD-8010 and assigned to @anya for bisect + kernel fix; estimation 3d. Leaving thread open for post-mortem notes.
